identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Marcus A Foster Educational Institute' (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 23-7357906, Oakland, CA)
Located in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda text

Founded in 1973 by Oakland Unified superintendent Marcus Foster to support Oakland schools, and a fiscal sponsor of youth programs funded by the City of Oakland and OUSD, matching a City-of-Oakland-funded student support services agreement
research.notes: Organization identity is solid, but it appears to have stopped normal operations: its listed website (marcusfoster.org) returns an empty page, its Franklin St office was lost in Dec 2023, and per Oaklandside (Feb 2024) it faced revocation of nonprofit status; GuideStar says it is not on the current IRS Business Master File. Phone, email, address and website were therefore deliberately omitted as stale and not verifiable on a live official page. CA entity number and UEI not found. Reviewer should decide whether to publish a profile for an apparently inactive organization.

profile.summary: A nonprofit founded in 1973 in Oakland, California, to support Oakland public schools. It gave scholarships to students and acted as a fiscal sponsor, handling money and paperwork for other community and youth programs.
